items.title: Bill Easley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 1, 2021
items.q: Miles Davis, Herbie Hancock, Ron Carter, Wayne Shorter, Tony Williams, they’re working at this club.

ctx.x: Do you feel you had like an internal voice or something that told you it was time to move on?

Oh yeah, man. See the internal voice, oh my God we could talk four hours about that. Again, I know I talk a lot but let me, let me tell you about the internal voice. Back in the army, stationed in Fairbanks, Alaska. Now around this time I’m 20 years old, right? So at one point I’m trying to figure out what am I going to do when I get out of the Army. Because I’d actually been working, I had a nice steady gig before I got drafted. Now I said when I get out I won’t have that youth going for me, and they won’t be…

I ran out of the club. I just ran out of the club. I didn’t even know, remember my name. I just ran out of the club. And so it was devastating but well, you know, there’s other things in the world that I could do. Then I go back to the base, clear as a bell the voice in my head said, “You’ve got to get with a giant. You’ve got to get with a giant.” In other words that means you’ve got to get with somebody that knows more than you do and so on and so on. So I listened to the voice and I went back to practicing and…
